name: Tencent Holdings Limited
blurb: Tencent Holdings is a Chinese multinational conglomerate and internet content & information company in the Communication Services sector. It operates social media, messaging, gaming, and digital payment platforms, including WeChat and QQ. With a market capitalization of approximately $744.8 billion, Tencent is one of the world's largest technology companies by market value.
